subject: Availability window & calendar invite for initial phone chat — options inside
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Michael Liu <michael.liu@example.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-08-30T08:15:00-04:00
Subject: Initial phone chat — 30 min windows (PDT availability)

Hi Michael —

Thanks for your interest in the Software Engineer role at Redwood Inference. I'd love to set up a 30-minute initial phone screen to learn more about your background and share the role details. I noticed your resume is on file (attached) but wanted to confirm a few windows that work on your side. I put these in PDT since your profile shows you're in Vancouver:

• Tue Aug 31 — 9:00–10:30 AM PDT
• Tue Aug 31 — 4:30–6:00 PM PDT
• Wed Sep 1 — 11:30 AM–1:00 PM PDT

If none of those are good, please suggest 2 other 30-minute slots (PDT) and I'll send an invite. Also let me know the best phone number to reach you and whether you'd like video.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Technical Recruiter | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: Michael_Liu_Resume.pdf
From: Michael Liu <michael.liu@example.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial phone chat — 30 min windows (PDT availability)

Hi Olga,

Thanks for reaching out and for proposing times. Evening slots work best for me this week — I can do Tue Aug 31 between 5:00–6:00 PM PDT or Wed Sep 1 at 11:30 AM PDT (both work). Phone is +1 (604) 555-0198. Video is fine but not required for the first screen.

If helpful, here is a direct calendar link where I usually share availability: https://calendly.com/michael-liu/30min (feel free to pick one).

Looking forward to it,
Michael
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Michael Liu <michael.liu@example.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-08-30T10:05:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Initial phone chat — 30 min windows (PDT availability)

Hi Michael —

Great, thanks for the quick reply and for the phone number. I'm going to book Tue Aug 31 at 5:15 PM PDT (30 min). I chose 5:15 to avoid the top-of-hour collision on our side — please confirm if 5:15–5:45 PM PDT is OK. I'll send an invite (ICS) to the address above and include a brief agenda.

Markus (hiring manager) — looping you in as a heads-up; if you prefer a different time, please let me know. Laura — can you help with calendar ops if we need to move after booking?

Thanks,
Olga
